milestone: Baked terrain/cave/prop ambient occlusion with clearer cast shadows

changes.terrain: Normal-aware multiscale horizon integration at actual receiver height
changes.caves: Cosine-weighted hemisphere sampling against cached shared tetrahedral solid, including signed/stacked floors and ceilings
changes.contacts: Soft elliptical footprints at tree roots, rocks, resources and outposts, with vertical falloff
changes.trees: Six directional probes at three heights interpolate ambient shading across dense leaf meshes
changes.comparison: Baked occlusion checkbox, shareable ao=0, invalidates cached reflection
changes.scope: Opaque mesh alpha stores the bake. Direct/emissive/scout/overlay contributions retain their separate treatment.

verified: Tree cast shadows and contact shading in entrance close-up
Cave cutaway and isolated shell with ceilings shown/hidden
browser_review.baseline_console_messages: Raylib logs its existing VAO/NPOT extension fallback notices at log level.

performance.scope: Single development-desktop observation; bake only, excluding meshing/upload/generation. No mobile or sustained frame-rate benchmark.

limitations: Finite angular/ray sampling and per-vertex interpolation; no full global illumination.
Prop contacts and foliage probes approximate cosmetic geometry; individual leaf triangles do not occlude each other.
Cutaway/isolation retain the complete cavity AO bake even when ceilings are hidden.
One-time bake adds work during synchronous world rebuilds; no AO rays run per frame.
